description: Ministry of Ports Shipping and Aviation - Civil Aviation Act, No. 14 of 2010
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister under the Civil Aviation Act, No. 14 of 2010. It specifically amends the Civil Aviation (Charges for the Use of Aerodromes) Regulations 2022, which falls under the category of regulatory frameworks and legal amendments. While it mentions a minister's name, this is in the context of his regulatory authority rather than a personnel appointment or detailed portfolio description. The core content is about legal/regulatory changes to aviation charges and exemptions.
